title: Vascular Neurology Considerations for Antiamyloid Immunotherapy: A Science Advisory From the American Heart Association
shortTitle: Vascular Neurology Considerations for Antiamyloid Immunotherapy

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: Antibodies directed at the amyloid-β peptide offer the prospect of disease-modifying therapy for early-stage Alzheimer disease but also carry the risk of brain edema or bleeding events, collectively designated amyloid-related imaging abnormalities.
